title: Terms and Conditions for Insight The City and ITC Club
content:
Effective date: October 13, 2026

These Terms set out the conditions for using the app, managing an account, subscribing to ITC Club, and redeeming Club benefits. Read them together with the Membership Terms, the conditions of each benefit, and the Privacy Policy available in the app.

# 1 Operator and scope

The Insight The City app and the ITC Club membership program are operated by Eventland LLC, a limited liability company organized under the laws of New Jersey, United States. In these Terms, “Eventland,” “ITC,” “we,” “us,” and “our” refer to Eventland LLC in its capacity as the operator of these services.

These Terms govern the relationship between Eventland and individuals who use the app, create an account, or access Club benefits. Participating businesses and service providers are referred to as “Partners” or “Establishments.” Their participation does not make them owners of Eventland or mean that their services are provided by Eventland.

# 2 Acceptance and related documents

Before creating an account or using features that require acceptance, you will have access to these Terms and must accept them through the action indicated in the app. If you do not accept them, you may not use the features subject to that acceptance.

Membership is also governed by the Membership Terms and the offer presented before you subscribe. Each benefit is subject to the specific conditions displayed before activation or redemption. Those conditions may not eliminate rights established by law.

The Privacy Policy explains how personal information is handled. Acceptance of these Terms does not replace any specific consent or permission required for particular uses of data, features, or communications.

Creating an account or accepting these Terms does not, by itself, authorize a payment or subscription. Any paid subscription or purchase requires an additional action and authorization.

# 3 Age and personal accounts

To create an account or subscribe, you must be at least 18 years old, have reached the age of majority in your jurisdiction of residence, and have the legal capacity to enter into a contract.

Your account information must be accurate and kept up to date. You must protect your login credentials and notify us if you become aware of unauthorized access. You may not lend, sell, or transfer your account, or use additional accounts to circumvent benefit restrictions or limits.

Establishments may impose higher age limits or other admission requirements for certain products or activities. Membership does not allow you to bypass legal, identification, or safety requirements.

# 4 Free app content

The free version allows you to view news, information, and free or paid events in New York, including events that are not part of ITC Club. It also allows you to view benefits published by Club Establishments. An ITC Club subscription is optional and is not required to view the free content. Some features may require an account.

Viewing a benefit does not entitle you to redeem it. Club benefits require an active membership and compliance with the conditions of the relevant offer. Promotional membership access is subject to its own conditions.

An event listing in the app does not mean that admission is included in membership, that the event is a Club benefit, or that Eventland organizes it. The relevant listing will identify any connection to ITC Club.

# 5 Monthly membership

ITC Club offers a personal, paid monthly membership that provides access to available benefits while the membership remains active. Benefits apply to goods or services provided by Establishments and consumed or delivered outside the app. The membership fee does not automatically include the price of tickets, meals, products, reservations, or other services provided by Establishments.

The subscription renews monthly until canceled, provided that automatic renewal has been disclosed and authorized in advance. Before you subscribe, you will be informed of the price, billing period, applicable charges, and conditions of any promotion. Payments are processed through the provider identified at the time of subscription.

You may cancel renewal at any time using the option available in the app. Cancellation stops future renewals and allows you to continue using benefits until the end of the current paid membership period. You may then continue using the free version of the app while retaining your account, without any obligation to subscribe again.

Canceling the subscription does not delete your account. If you request account deletion, the account deletion provisions of these Terms apply. Refunds, promotional periods, and other billing details are governed by the Membership Terms, the offer accepted when subscribing, and any rights established by law.

Membership does not guarantee a specific amount of savings or the indefinite availability of an Establishment or offer, unless a subscription offer expressly promises otherwise. This provision does not permit the withdrawal of expressly promised services or restrict a subscriber’s rights in the event of a breach.

# 6 Conditions for using benefits

To redeem a benefit, you must hold an active membership and comply with the published conditions of that offer. Conditions may include dates, hours, location, advance reservations, minimum spending, included products, usage limits, availability, and rules concerning guests or the combination of promotions.

Membership, QR codes, discount codes, and all other benefits obtained through the Club are personal and nontransferable. They may not be sold, lent, shared publicly, or used to allow redemption by anyone other than the member.

If an offer includes guests or family members, the member may use that offer within its expressly stated conditions. This does not transfer membership or authorize independent use of the benefit by a third party.

A benefit may be combined with other promotions only if its conditions allow it. Relevant restrictions must be displayed before activation, reservation, or payment. You must follow the redemption instructions at the Establishment or on its website.

# 7 QR code activation and expiration

QR codes expire 24 hours after activation. An expired QR code cannot be used. The frequency of activation and the permitted number of redemptions are those specified for each benefit.

The QR code must be presented in accordance with the app’s instructions and validated through the Establishment’s procedure. It may not be altered, reproduced to enable unauthorized use, transferred, or used after its permitted redemptions have been exhausted.

Activating a QR code does not make a reservation, purchase a ticket, or guarantee availability beyond the published conditions. It also does not extend membership: your membership must remain active when you redeem the benefit.

If an ITC technical issue prevents you from using a valid QR code, contact us for review. Expiration rules do not eliminate rights that apply when the inability to use a benefit results from a breach by Eventland.

# 8 Purchases and services provided by Establishments

Eventland sells the ITC Club membership. Purchases of tickets, experiences, food, products, or services associated with benefits are made directly from the Establishment offering them, at its premises or through its sales channels.

The Establishment is responsible for the sale, payment collection, delivery, and provision of its product or service, as well as its premises, staff, quality, safety, permits, and legal obligations. It also handles its reservations, cancellations, changes, and refunds in accordance with the conditions disclosed to the purchaser and applicable law.

Eventland does not organize or provide those services merely by including them in the Club. Our responsibilities relate to operating the app, providing membership, and fulfilling the commitments we make concerning access to and operation of benefits. This does not exclude responsibility for our own acts, omissions, or breaches.

Before paying, review the final price, included items, and the Establishment’s policies. The benefit applies to the pricing basis stated in the offer; taxes, service charges, tips, or additional items are included only if expressly stated.

# 9 Redemption problems and customer support

If a valid benefit does not work, an Establishment refuses to honor it, or there is a discrepancy with the published conditions, contact ITC through the support channels indicated in the app or email ITCClub@insightthecity.com. Whenever possible, do so before completing a purchase or proceeding with a redemption that does not match the offer.

To review the issue, we may request relevant information, such as the Establishment, date, benefit, error message, a screenshot of the conditions, or a receipt. Do not send passwords or complete payment card numbers.

ITC will review the issue and, where appropriate, coordinate with the Establishment to apply the offer or correct the problem. If the published conditions and expressly disclosed availability requirements are met, the benefit must be honored as offered.

A purchase from an Establishment does not automatically create an obligation for Eventland to issue a refund. Eventland remains responsible for its own commitments and for any remedies required under the Membership Terms and applicable law.

Seeking our assistance is not a prerequisite to exercising legal rights, contacting an authority, filing a complaint, or expressing an honest opinion about a service. You do not need to wait for our response in an emergency or a situation requiring immediate attention.

# 10 Benefit availability and changes

The catalog may add, update, or remove Establishments and benefits. An offer may depend on hours, capacity, dates, or availability, provided that these conditions are disclosed clearly.

Changes will be reflected in the app and may not retroactively modify a purchase or reservation already confirmed with an Establishment. Activating a benefit is not equivalent to a confirmed purchase or reservation unless its conditions expressly state otherwise.

If an offer becomes unavailable after activation, or a change affects a membership commitment, contact ITC to review the applicable solution. The ability to update the catalog does not authorize a breach of a service expressly offered when you subscribed.

# 11 Commercial relationships and commissions

ITC Club maintains commercial agreements with its Partners. Some Establishments pay to participate in the Club; others may participate by invitation without paying a fee. Eventland may also receive commissions on certain purchases or reservations made through links or codes, or receive other consideration related to a collaboration.

When a commercial relationship requires disclosure, it will be identified clearly and prominently in the relevant profile, benefit, link, or content. This general explanation does not replace specific disclosures that must accompany individual offers or recommendations.

Receiving a commission or other compensation does not make Eventland the provider of the product or service. It does not, by itself, change the price shown to the user; applicable prices and charges must be disclosed in the offer and at the point of purchase.

# 12 Intellectual property and permitted use

The trademarks, text, photographs, videos, designs, and other materials in the app belong to their respective rights holders or are used with permission. These Terms do not assign to Eventland ownership of rights belonging to Insight The City, its rights holders, Partners, or other third parties.

You may view content for personal use and use the available sharing features. You may not commercially exploit, distribute, or reproduce protected materials without permission, except where permitted by law.

You may not compromise security, access another person’s account, manipulate codes or redemption records, extract data through methods that violate rights or access controls, interfere with the app, or use it for unlawful activities.

These Terms govern ITC’s services and do not replace Apple’s standard license or applicable Google Play distribution terms. Use of the software is subject to the license of the relevant app store, where applicable, without reducing Eventland’s express membership commitments or consumers’ legal rights.

# 13 Information and service interruptions

News, schedules, prices, and event information may change after publication. We will identify the relevant conditions available when publishing and review errors brought to our attention. Before traveling to an event or making a purchase, check the organizer’s or Establishment’s current information.

The app may require maintenance or experience technical interruptions. Eventland will seek to correct issues within its control and communicate significant interruptions where possible.

An interruption does not eliminate obligations expressly undertaken for a paid membership. If an interruption materially prevents use of the subscribed service, the solutions provided in the Membership Terms and any rights established by law will apply.

# 14 Account suspension and deletion

Eventland may restrict features, suspend an account, or close an account when there are reasonable grounds involving fraud, unauthorized transfers of benefits, manipulation of redemptions, security risks, serious or repeated violations of these rules, or a legal obligation.

Measures will be proportionate. Unless there is an urgent security issue or legal restriction, we will explain the reason and provide a way to request review or correct the problem. An account will not be suspended solely because its holder files a legitimate complaint or expresses an honest negative opinion.

You may initiate account deletion at any time through the clearly visible option available in the app. You do not need to email support to initiate that process. Retention and deletion of personal information are described in the Privacy Policy.

Deleting your account also cancels the associated subscription and stops future renewals. Deletion ends access to features and benefits that require that account. If you want to stop renewal while retaining access until your membership expires, use the subscription cancellation option and keep your account active.

Account deletion does not, by itself, cancel purchases or reservations already confirmed directly with an Establishment. The treatment of amounts already paid is governed by the Membership Terms, the applicable purchase conditions, and rights established by law.

Uninstalling the app or signing out does not cancel your subscription or delete your account. Use the relevant options available in the app.

If Eventland decides to discontinue a membership, it must address the resulting billing consequences and any amounts due in accordance with the agreed conditions and applicable law. Termination does not extinguish outstanding obligations or rights already acquired.

# 15 Responsibility and consumer rights

Each party remains responsible for its own obligations and conduct. Eventland does not assume an Establishment’s exclusive obligations concerning a product or service that the Establishment sells and provides directly, but remains responsible for its own legal and contractual obligations concerning the app and membership.

These Terms do not exclude liability for fraud, willful misconduct, gross negligence, personal injury, or other harm for which liability cannot legally be excluded. They do not establish a general waiver of the right to seek damages or obtain remedies provided by law.

New Jersey users retain all rights and remedies available under the Consumer Fraud Act, the Truth-in-Consumer Contract, Warranty and Notice Act, and other applicable laws. Users in other locations retain the mandatory protections available to them, including New York protections where applicable.

No rule concerning redemption, suspension, catalog changes, or customer support may be interpreted as a waiver of those rights, an exclusion of liability for Eventland’s own breach, or a prohibition on contacting authorities or courts.

# 16 Communications and amendments

We may send communications necessary to administer your account, membership, redemptions, security, and contractual updates. Promotional communications and notification permissions are managed through your preferences and the relevant unsubscribe options. Membership does not require you to receive advertising.

If we amend these Terms, we will publish the updated version and its effective date. Material changes will be communicated reasonably in advance through available contact channels, except for urgent changes required by law or necessary to protect security.

Changes will not apply retroactively to earlier events or claims or authorize new charges by themselves. We will request renewed acceptance where required. If a change materially affects a membership already paid for, we will honor the agreed conditions and the cancellation options or remedies provided in the Membership Terms and applicable law.

# 17 Governing law and complaints

These Terms are governed by the laws of New Jersey, without displacing mandatory consumer protections or applicable legal rules on jurisdiction and venue.

You may contact Eventland to try to resolve a disagreement. This process is voluntary and does not prevent a complaint to an authority or an action in a court with jurisdiction. These Terms do not impose mandatory arbitration or a waiver of class actions or a trial where legally available.

If a provision is held invalid, the remaining provisions will continue to apply to the extent they can operate independently and preserve the purpose of the agreement, without restoring through a different interpretation an obligation that is contrary to law.

# 18 Contact and notices

Operator: Eventland LLC.

Services: Insight The City app and ITC Club membership.

Support and complaints email: ITCClub@insightthecity.com.

Service of legal process and other communications requiring a specific legal form must comply with applicable rules. The support email does not replace those procedures.
